sources.note: No stress statement for Sindihui. Metadata row: SanMateoSindihuiMixtec, Group 4, Eastern Alta/Teozacoalco, only SOURCE=josserand1983mixtec. Table 4 row 'San Mateo Sindihui sind11 sind.. 0' (0% entries tone-marked). Its only stress remarks concern other varieties (Diuxi: 'non-predictable word-final stress, which is a feature of tone', quoting Daly 1978; a Cuicatec source: 'stress and vowel length are correlated').
